goal: Find correctness defects in the Bakeoff multi-lens and parallel-flow code paths across the named target files.
background: Branch: main, HEAD: d7cc4a4 (runtime visibility); local uncommitted changes exist in internal/runner/runner.go and others; review the current working tree.
Review target files (all 7, no other files):
- skills/bakeoff-run/SKILL.md (411 lines) - drafting and multi-lens contract for /bakeoff:run
- commands/run.md (15 lines) - slash command entry point
- references/run-appendix.md (205 lines) - split and multi-lens preview templates and presets
- internal/commands/researchcmd/run.go (1031 lines) - research command implementation including multi-lens fanout
- internal/runner/runner.go (1106 lines) - provider runner and concurrency layer
Scope: multi-lens and parallel-flow code paths and their interactions across these 7 files.
Lens: CORRECTNESS only. Reliability and maintainability are covered by sibling lens runs.
Acceptance for findings: every finding must cite file:line and explain the wrong behavior, the expected behavior, and a concrete trigger scenario.

facet.focus: Logic bugs in the multi-lens fanout, parser or serializer mismatches, off-by-one errors, error handling that drops or misroutes failures, concurrency hazards, and missing edge cases in the triage state machine.
include: logic bugs and off-by-one errors with file:line evidence
parser, JSON, or schema mismatches between writer and reader sides
concurrency hazards: data races, missed locks, unsafe map or slice sharing across goroutines
error handling that swallows, misclassifies, or returns wrong exit codes for known failure modes
edge cases in triage state transitions (empty input, duplicates, stale data, repeated transitions)
incorrect run-id, path, or filename collision resolution in multi-lens or split fanout
contract drift between the skill (SKILL.md, run-appendix.md) and the code that implements it
exclude: issues outside the 7 named target files
style or naming preferences (covered by the maintainability lens)
reliability concerns: timeouts, retries, leak risks, crash safety (covered by the reliability lens)
broad rewrite proposals unrelated to a specific defect
